items.t: Trump, Xi and Putin say nuclear war cannot be won
items.d: After a rare three-way meeting, the leaders pledged talks to cut nuclear risk, though Putin admitted the joint statement sets no ambitious goals.

items.t: UK and EU seal post-Brexit reset deal
items.d: A Brussels summit agreed youth mobility, a food and plant trade deal and linked carbon markets. Burnham says it could add 0.5% to the economy; the EU wants lower tuition fees for its students.

items.t: Russian strikes kill eight in Kyiv; objects cross into Poland
items.d: Overnight attacks also killed two in Lviv and injured 28 across nine regions, while Poland investigates objects reported as missiles and a drone near its border.

items.t: World Court rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.d: The ICJ ruled 9-6 against Myanmar, which rejected the verdict. The UK expelled Myanmar's defence attaché in response.

items.t: Senate Republicans block Iran war-powers vote
items.d: The resolution failed 51-48 as Trump said he will not decide his next step on Iran until the new year.

items.t: Estonia to shut Russian border for six months
items.d: Moscow accused Tallinn of building a new 'iron curtain' and warned of political and diplomatic retaliation.

items.t: Anthropic's record IPO fails to calm AI jitters
items.d: The listing raised about $81bn and valued Anthropic near $1.5 trillion, but tech shares slid and the Nasdaq erased its gains for the year.

items.t: California subpoenas Nvidia over chips reaching China
items.d: State attorney general Rob Bonta is probing whether Nvidia chips were diverted to China, adding pressure on the AI chip leader.

items.t: US sells first deep-sea mining lease off American Samoa
items.d: Wetstone U.S. Ventures paid $6m for 31.5 million acres of seabed, a first that alarms environmental groups.

items.t: Apple reportedly building an AI agent to run your Mac
items.d: The early-stage agent could operate apps, browse the web and write code, Apple's answer to rivals' computer-use AI.

items.t: Google's Gemini can now use your Mac for you
items.d: Gemini for Mac can sort files, fill in forms and drive apps, first for US paying subscribers in English.

items.t: Meta's Muse AI agent reportedly leaked private data
items.d: Users reportedly saw strangers' childcare messages, reminders and bank balances, raising fresh privacy worries about AI agents.

items.t: AI-assisted cyberattack hits European Commission
items.d: The attack briefly disrupted staff payroll and medical claims systems; investigators linked it to an AI security-testing tool.

items.t: Google picks Blue Origin to launch AI servers into orbit
items.d: Project Suncatcher satellites, each with data-centre-rack computing power, are due to launch in early 2029.

items.t: ChatGPT Live Dictation rolls out worldwide
items.d: OpenAI's feature turns speech into text as you talk, expanding voice input for all users.

items.t: Two stars may be feeding the Milky Way's black hole
items.d: Astronomers traced gas clouds near the central black hole to a massive star pair whose colliding winds shed material.

items.t: Compound burns fat without losing muscle, in mice
items.d: UC Berkeley researchers found a compound that makes the body burn more energy rather than suppressing appetite.

items.t: Fungal toxins found in all 212 plant-based foods tested
items.d: Researchers tested vegan and vegetarian products and found mycotoxins in every one, though levels varied.

items.t: EU says reset hinges on lower tuition fees for its students
items.d: Brussels says the deal will not take effect unless the UK cuts fees or agrees an alternative within six months; Farage called Burnham 'naive'.

items.t: UK expels Myanmar's defence attaché after genocide ruling
items.d: London acted after the World Court found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya.

items.t: Two men to face trial over alleged Iran-linked RAF Fairford plot
items.d: Prosecutors say the September incident was directed from Iran; the trial is set for November 2027.

items.t: 特朗普、習近平、普京聲明核戰無贏家
items.d: 三方罕有會面後，三國領袖承諾就降低核風險展開對話，但普京承認聯合聲明未有訂下宏大目標。

items.t: 英國與歐盟敲定脫歐後關係重啟協議
items.d: 布魯塞爾峰會同意青年流動計劃、動植物產品貿易協議及連接碳排放市場。賓咸稱可令經濟增長0.5%；歐盟則要求英國調低歐盟學生學費。

items.t: 俄軍空襲基輔八死　不明物體闖波蘭領空
items.d: 俄軍夜間空襲亦令利沃夫兩人死亡，九個地區共28人受傷；波蘭正調查邊境附近疑為導彈及無人機的不明物體。

items.t: 國際法院裁定緬甸對羅興亞人犯種族滅絕罪
items.d: 國際法院以9比6裁定緬甸罪成，緬甸拒絕接受。英國隨即驅逐緬甸駐英國防武官。

items.t: 美國參議院共和黨人否決伊朗戰爭權力決議
items.d: 決議以51比48被否決；特朗普表示要到新年才決定對伊朗的下一步行動。

items.t: 愛沙尼亞將關閉對俄邊境至少半年
items.d: 莫斯科指責愛沙尼亞築起新「鐵幕」，並警告會採取政治及外交報復。

items.t: Anthropic破紀錄上市　未能平息AI憂慮
items.d: 是次上市集資約810億美元，估值近1.5萬億美元，但科技股下挫，納斯達克指數今年升幅全數蒸發。

items.t: 加州向Nvidia發傳票　調查晶片流入中國
items.d: 加州總檢察長邦塔調查Nvidia晶片是否被轉運至中國，令這家AI晶片龍頭再添壓力。

items.t: 美國首次出售美屬薩摩亞外海深海採礦權
items.d: Wetstone U.S. Ventures以600萬美元取得3150萬英畝海床採礦權，屬首例，令環保團體憂慮。

items.t: 傳Apple研發可操控Mac的AI代理
items.d: 這個仍在早期階段的代理可操作程式、瀏覽網頁及編寫程式碼，是Apple對抗對手「操控電腦」AI的回應。

items.t: Google Gemini可代用戶操作Mac
items.d: Mac版Gemini可整理檔案、填寫表格及操作程式，首先開放予美國付費英文用戶。

items.t: 傳Meta AI代理Muse外洩私隱資料
items.d: 據報用戶看到陌生人的托兒訊息、提醒事項及銀行結餘，再引起外界對AI代理私隱的憂慮。

items.t: 歐盟委員會遭AI輔助網絡攻擊
items.d: 攻擊一度影響職員薪酬及醫療報銷系統；調查人員指與一款AI保安測試工具有關。

items.t: Google選Blue Origin發射太空AI伺服器
items.d: Suncatcher計劃的衛星每枚具備一個數據中心機架的運算能力，預計2029年初發射。

items.t: ChatGPT即時聽寫功能全球推出
items.d: OpenAI新功能可一邊說話一邊轉成文字，令所有用戶都能更方便以語音輸入。

items.t: 兩顆恆星或為銀河系黑洞提供「食糧」
items.d: 天文學家追蹤到中央黑洞附近的氣體雲，來自一對大質量恆星互相碰撞的星風。

items.t: 新化合物助燃脂而不減肌肉（小鼠實驗）
items.d: 加州大學柏克萊分校研究人員發現一種化合物，令身體消耗更多能量，而非抑制食慾。

items.t: 測試212款素食產品　全部含真菌毒素
items.d: 研究人員測試全素及素食產品，發現每一款都含真菌毒素，惟含量各有不同。

items.t: 歐盟稱重啟協議取決於調低歐盟學生學費
items.d: 歐盟表示，除非英國調低學費或在六個月內同意替代方案，否則協議不會生效；法拉奇批評賓咸「天真」。

items.t: 英國因種族滅絕裁決驅逐緬甸國防武官
items.d: 國際法院裁定緬甸須為對羅興亞人的種族滅絕負責後，英國採取行動。

items.t: 兩男涉伊朗指使費爾福德空軍基地事件受審
items.d: 檢方指九月的事件由伊朗指使；案件定於2027年11月開審。
